remarks: First time on the market in over 60 years. This 4+2, 1666 sq. ft. home is ideally located in the highly desirable Seaside area of South Torrance. It is also known as The Christmas Lights Area and Sleepy Hollow. Enjoy the cool ocean breezes from the close proximity to the beach. Walk to The Riviera Village, restaurants and shopping, as well as award winning schools. It is less than a block to the back entrance to Seaside Elementary and 2 blocks to Sea Aire golf course. This home has been well maintained but could use a new owner to reimagine it to its full potential with a fresh look The 4th bedroom has been used as a dining room but can easily be converted back to a bedroom by reinstalling
